chore(ci): bump actions to Node 24 versions (#1592)

## Summary
- Bump JavaScript actions to majors that ship `using: node24`, so the
runtime moves off Node 20.
- Bump CI `node-version` from 20 to 22 (Node 20 reached end-of-life in
April 2026).
- GitHub is forcing JavaScript actions to Node 24 by default on
2026-06-02 and removing Node 20 from runners on 2026-09-16.

Action bumps:
- `actions/checkout@v4` → `@v5`
- `actions/setup-node@v4` → `@v5`
- `docker/setup-qemu-action@v3` → `@v4`
- `docker/setup-buildx-action@v3` → `@v4`
- `docker/build-push-action@v6` → `@v7`
- `azure/login@v2` → `@v3`
- `oras-project/setup-oras@v1` → `@v2`

chore: flatten repo to single-package layout (#1567)

chore: flatten repo to single-package layout (#1567)

## Summary
- Drop the deprecated `playwright-cli-stub` workspace (it was squatting
the old `playwright-cli` npm name and had no CI publish step — unlikely
to be re-published).
- Move `packages/playwright-mcp/*` to the repo root, since
`@playwright/mcp` is now the only published package.
- Update `Dockerfile`, CI/publish workflows, `roll.js`,
`update-readme.js` and `.claude/settings.local.json` to drop the
`packages/playwright-mcp/` prefix and workspace plumbing.

Verified locally: `npm install` + `npm run lint` produce no README diff,
`npm pack --dry-run` yields the same 7-file tarball (`LICENSE`,
`README.md`, `cli.js`, `config.d.ts`, `index.d.ts`, `index.js`,
`package.json`), and `tests/cli.spec.ts` passes.
